chore(skills): install the commit skill from mrsimpson/skills-coding

## Intent

Most commits of the agentic app-creation increment say what changed but not why; the intent stayed in the sessions and was lost. Agents working in this repo should load a commit skill that asks for the why in every message.

## Key changes

- Every commit message gets a conventional subject and a body with "Intent", "Key changes" and, where it applies, "Dependencies and side effects".
- The skill is installed with npx skills add and pinned in skills-lock.json; .claude/skills/commit links it for Claude Code.
- The pre-push hook counts .agents/, .claude/ and skills-lock.json as root-only paths, since no template's check needs them.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The same skill is installed in every platform repository of lernapps: apps 30e7c66, lernapps.github.io ce3c87f, docs 55b3bf5, .github 2ef3256, tooling 65863ee.

tooling.reason: A fix of the pre-commit hook that the skill install needed; a change of its own, so it stays apart.
tooling.message:
fix(hooks): a commit of only files the formatter ignores passes the pre-commit hook

## Intent

Committing only skills-lock.json and a skill failed the pre-commit hook: the formatter ignores both, so it got no file and exited with an error.

## Key changes

- The hook's formatter step no longer counts an empty set of files as an error; staged code is formatted as before.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Lets tooling 65863ee commit the commit skill.

tooling.reason: A fix of the e2e tests that the skill install needed; a change of its own, so it stays apart.
tooling.message:
test: the repo copy of the e2e tests keeps symlinks

## Intent

The e2e tests copy the repo file by file into a fresh repository. A tracked symlink to a folder, such as the .claude/skills/commit link that the skill install writes for Claude Code, made the copy fail, and nine test files failed.

## Key changes

- A symlink is copied as a symlink with the same target, as git clone would check it out; every other file is copied as before.

## Dependencies and side effects

- Lets the tests pass with tooling 65863ee.

tooling.reason: The skill install itself; it follows the two fixes, which stay commits of their own.
